basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast from Dublin, currently exploring the world of Linux and open-source software. I recently made the switch to Manjaro with KDE and Wayland, and I'm thrilled with the performance improvements. My interests include tech, Buddhism, and binge-watching 'Derry Girls'. By day, I work as a junior software developer, and by night, I'm usually diving into new tech trends or meditating. I'm single and enjoy spending my free time exploring new hobbies. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have been self-teaching Linux through online forums and tutorials. My interest in technology extends to experimenting with different operating systems and understanding their underlying architecture.
